Chest card: item icon size

Mock-up from the game's own icons (embedded, 128 px; full size in research/analysis/item-icons). "As now" stretches each icon over the whole picture area, as v0.101 does. "Evened out" scales each icon so its visible part fills the target fraction of the frame, centred on its visible part. The ring and ink are an approximation of the game's frame. Click an item to show it on the big card.
